notes.title: v1.1041 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

Here is the summary of latest update:

 Fixed a game-breaking bug in Snowy Islands (3rd Level)


Also we increased the playtime of the demo by adding the Ring World (2nd Level). Feel free to check it out if you didn't play the game yet!

Have a nice adventure!
Ashina Studios
